summary: A battlefield where War‑Shades rise from corrupted shadows and clash endlessly.
description: The Warshade Field is the battlefield memory of the Fracture Plains. It is a landscape of deep trenches, broken pikes, and weathered fortifications that seem to have belonged to a dozen different wars all at once. The grass is black and brittle, the soil stained by iron and ash, and the air carries a constant low hum of conflict. In the distance, shadow figures seem to walk among the ruined lines, only to vanish when the eye lands on them.
history: Shadow rifts opened across the field.

mountains: Low ridges and broken hillocks that ring the battlefield like ancient walls.
Basalt outcroppings that hold old weapon pits and ruined siege engines.
rivers: The Mourning Run, a dark channel that follows the old front lines.
The Tainted Ditch, a bone-dry trench that fills with black water during storms.
forests: Broken thornwoods and ash-wasted groves along the field edges.
Shadow-black scrub that grows from old graves and ruined fortifications.
notableFeatures: Battle trenches that stretch in ragged lines across the plain.
Shadow pools reflecting false armies and ghosted cavalry charges.
Collapsed memorial cairns and ruined watchtowers half swallowed by the earth.
